messages:
maria_csm: Quick roundup from this week's onboarding calls 5 customers gave similar feedback: unclear 'route' concept, surprise token billing spikes, and a couple of infra disconnects. Can we prioritize quick customer-facing artifacts?

tom_csm: Yep. Biggest asks: per-route CSV export, clearer in-product labels for routes, and a KB article showing how to estimate token cost per route.

aj_product: Agree on triage. Short-term: CS-facing artifacts (KB + CSV export) and infra mitigation for timeouts. Medium-term: UI labels & per-route billing reports.

leo_se: For the timeouts we saw earlier, adding a keepalive and bumping LB idle on onboarding fleet reduces disconnects. I'll prepare a flag so we can toggle quickly.

emma_docs: I can write a KB article and a short quickstart section for reranking examples. I'll need a sample CSV schema to show the mapping of route -> tokens.

feedback-bot: Applied tags: [onboarding], [billing], [docs-request].

aj_product: Action items: (1) Leo -> add keepalive + LB tweak on onboarding fleet (owner: leo_se; ETA: 48h). (2) Leo -> admin CSV export endpoint returning rows: customer, route, tokens, window (owner: leo_se; ETA: 72h). (3) Emma -> KB article + quickstart examples (owner: emma_docs; ETA: 3 days). (4) CS -> flag renewal-risk customers and pause outreach until fix confirmed.

tom_csm: I'll pause outreach for the 3 at-risk accounts and message them with an acknowledgement + ETA once Leo confirms LB change.

emma_docs: Drafting KB now. Example CSV snippet I'll use:

```
customer,route,tokens,start_ts,end_ts
BrightLeaf,chat-default,3245,2026-03-01T10:00Z,2026-03-01T11:15Z
```

maria_csm: Thanks. Can product add a "renewal-risk" triage label in backlog so CS can elevate tickets? We had one that sat under low-priority and nearly rolled into churn.

aj_product: Will add triage label and a simple scoring field (impact 1-5). Also adding a short template for CS to provide frequency and severity so we can prioritize faster.

leo_se: LB change PR opened. Admin CSV endpoint implemented behind admin flag; will post instructions to CS once deployed to staging.

emma_docs: KB draft shared in Drive, feedback welcome. I'll include a 2-min screencap for the CSV export flow.

tom_csm: Pinged the at-risk accounts with a short note and expected timeline. Will escalate to sales if we see any negative responses.

maria_csm: Great work. Let's reconvene Friday morning if LB change and CSV endpoint are still pending. Otherwise we can close these quick-fixes and move per-route billing to roadmap grooming. :thumbsup:
